bot.name: Avalon Assistant
bot.welcome: 👋 Hello, I'm the Avalon Shipping virtual assistant. How can I help you make the most of the portal today?
bot.fallback: 🤖 Sorry, I didn't quite understand that. Try asking about the fleet, the map, agency requests or payments.

answers.about: 🚢 Avalon Shipping is a ship agency on the Danube. In the portal you follow vessels on the map, see which ports they call at and what cargo they carry, and open a detailed card for every ship.
answers.offer: 📌 You can plan calls, keep notes, work with partner companies, run day-to-day operations — and talk to your team and partners in the built-in chat and feed.
answers.agency: ⚓ To nominate Avalon for a Danube call, send an [agency request](/request). An agent replies right in the portal and the status changes as we work on it.
answers.fleet: 🛳️ The vessel board shows the whole fleet: add vessels, update their details and see the status and checklist of every call.
answers.map: 🗺️ The live map shows vessels in real time — current positions, routes and ports of call.
answers.notifications: 🔔 Badges in the menu show what needs attention: unread chats, new agency requests and vessels that sailed unpaid.
answers.reports: 📈 The dashboard sums up arrivals, open checklist items and unpaid calls, and documents are always at hand in the shared library.
answers.search: 🔎 Use search and filters to quickly find vessels, companies, cargo or ports.
answers.security: 🛡️ Your data is stored securely, and access depends on your role: admins, staff and clients each see only what they need.
answers.team: 👥 Admins add team members, assign roles and permissions, and every change in the log carries the author's name.
answers.history: 📜 The change log keeps the full history of vessel updates, movements and user actions.
answers.automation: 🤖 Routine steps are handled for you: checklist progress and ETA countdowns update automatically.
answers.pricing: 💸 Port costs depend on the vessel and the call. Get an instant [PDA estimate](/estimate), then send an agency request for a firm quote.
answers.payment: 💳 Agency calls are paid against the agent's invoice, and portal services are paid from your credit balance — see **Balance** in the menu.
answers.support: 🛟 I can help with agency requests and payments. What do you need help with?
answers.greeting: 👋 Hello! How can I help you today?
